macroTarget.note: Trainer target for Jmo: fat loss, lean muscle gain, and metabolism support. Daily structure is 3 whole-food meals plus 1 high-protein snack.

dailyHabits: Hit 155-160g protein before worrying about perfection elsewhere.
Build meals from lean protein, approved carbohydrates, vegetables, and controlled healthy fats.
Use the 30g protein list for fast swaps when travel, kids, or work blow up the plan.
Log meals, workout, water, and weight once per day.

trackerDefaults.workoutGoal: Complete planned lift/cardio or active recovery

recipeLibrary.name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Almonds
instructions: Combine Greek yogurt and berries in a bowl.
Top with chopped almonds.

recipeLibrary.name: Spinach and Feta Omelet
instructions: Cook spinach in olive oil until wilted.
Add beaten eggs, cook until set, add feta, and fold.

recipeLibrary.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked through.
Build salad with vegetables, top with chicken, and drizzle vinaigrette.

recipeLibrary.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Bake salmon and asparagus at 400F for 12-15 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Broccoli
instructions: Cook garlic and shrimp until pink.
Saute broccoli until tender.
Combine and finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Turkey Meatballs with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Bake turkey meatballs at 375F for 20-25 minutes.
Pulse cauliflower into rice and saute until tender.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Chicken and Quinoa Casserole
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Turkey and Vegetable Chili
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Brown turkey.
Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place beef and broccoli in crockpot.
Mix sauce separately, pour over, and cook on low for 5-7 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Lemon Garlic Chicken
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot.
Pour lemon garlic mixture over chicken and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

dealsSource.harrisTeeter: Checked Harris Teeter Aug 12-18, 2026 public weekly-ad sources during the Aug 15 cron. Current protein highlights found: ground chuck, New York strip steak, Boston butt pork roast, ground chicken, pork chops, pork loin, tuna steaks, shrimp, sockeye salmon, trout, catfish, tilapia, mahi mahi, and flounder. Use this as a planning board and verify Belmont shelf tags/e-VIC before relying on exact pricing.
dealsSource.aldi: Checked ALDI Aug 12-18, 2026 public weekly-ad sources during the Aug 15 cron. Public store-level pricing was less precise for Belmont; current or near-current protein mentions include Atlantic salmon, ground turkey, chicken drumsticks, ground beef burgers, and marinated pork strips. Treat ALDI items as good cross-checks, not guaranteed local sale prices.

harristeeter.item: Tilapia, mahi mahi, flounder, trout, catfish, or tuna steaks

freezerRecommendations.reason: Best planning anchor this week: lean, easy to season, and works for taco bowls, lettuce cups, chili, or pasta sauce.
Lean seafood helps close protein without pushing fat high; freeze extra flat if the pack size is bigger than one dinner.
Good family-volume dinner protein; slice into medallions and pair with green vegetables plus a measured carb.

meals.name: HT Ground Chicken Taco Rice Bowls
meals.vegetable: Bell peppers, lettuce, salsa, and onions
meals.dealHighlight: Best lean weeknight anchor from the HT ad notes.
meals.macroFit: High-protein bowl with controlled carbs; use Greek yogurt instead of sour cream.
ingredients: Salsa and plain non-fat Greek yogurt
instructions: Brown ground chicken with taco seasoning.
Saute peppers and onion until crisp-tender.
Serve over measured brown rice with lettuce, salsa, lime, and Greek yogurt.
Pack leftovers as bowls or lettuce cups.

meals.name: HT Sockeye Salmon Broccoli Sweet Potato Plates
meals.dealHighlight: Best clean seafood dinner from the HT ad notes.
meals.macroFit: Protein plus healthy fat; keep oil light and let sweet potato carry the carb.
instructions: Roast cubed sweet potatoes at 425F until tender.
Roast or steam broccoli with measured oil.
Bake salmon with lemon, garlic, and dill until just cooked.
Plate with a measured sweet potato portion and extra broccoli.

meals.name: HT Pork Loin Green Bean Quinoa Plates
meals.salePrice: Pork loin or pork chops weekly-ad protein highlight
meals.dealHighlight: Good family-volume protein if the shelf tag confirms the pork deal.
meals.macroFit: Lean enough for dinner if trimmed; quinoa adds useful carbs without making the plate heavy.
instructions: Season pork loin with mustard, garlic, rosemary, and pepper.
Roast until cooked through, then rest before slicing.
Steam or roast green beans with measured oil.
Serve sliced pork with quinoa and green beans.

meals.name: ALDI Turkey Burger Potato Salad Plates
meals.salePrice: Ground turkey or ground beef burger mentions; check local ALDI pricing
meals.dealHighlight: Good ALDI backup meal if ground turkey pricing checks out in store.
meals.macroFit: Simple high-protein plate; skip the bun and use potatoes as the measured carb.
ingredients: Large salad kit or romaine and cucumbers
instructions: Form turkey into patties and season well.
Roast potatoes until crisp with measured oil.
Grill or pan-sear patties until cooked through.
Serve bunless with salad, pickles, mustard, and measured potatoes.

meals.name: HT Shrimp Vegetable Stir-Fry Rice Bowls
meals.dealHighlight: Fastest lean protein option in this week's HT seafood list.
meals.macroFit: Excellent protein catch-up meal; keep sauce light and rice measured.
ingredients: 2 lb mixed vegetables or broccoli slaw
5 cups cooked jasmine or brown rice
Low-sodium soy sauce or coconut aminos
instructions: Cook vegetables in a hot skillet until browned.
Add shrimp, garlic, and ginger; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Finish with soy sauce or coconut aminos and lime.
Serve over measured rice.

meals.name: HT Tilapia Tacos with Cabbage Slaw and Black Beans
meals.salePrice: Tilapia and other white fish weekly-ad seafood highlights
meals.dealHighlight: Flexible fish taco night using whichever HT white fish has the best shelf tag.
meals.macroFit: Lean protein and high-volume slaw; keep tortillas to 2 and add beans for controlled carbs.
ingredients: 2 lb tilapia, flounder, or mahi mahi
10 small corn or whole wheat tortillas
instructions: Season fish with chili powder, cumin, garlic, and lime.
Bake or pan-sear until flaky.
Mix slaw with Greek yogurt, lime, cilantro, and pepper.
Serve fish in tortillas with slaw and a measured side of black beans.
